comedian.description: A witty comedian that tells, catalogs, counts, and lists jokes

general.description: General assistant for various tasks, questions, and help

architect-orchestrator.description: Central orchestrator for EA workflows. Determines ADM cycle, delegates to specialist agents based on project state.

cto.description: CTO advisor: Strategic technology decisions, investment approvals, vendor evaluation, technology roadmap. ADM Phase A (Vision).

ba-agent.description: Business Analyst: Requirements elicitation, PRD creation, user stories, acceptance criteria. ADM Phase A.

compliance.description: Compliance Architect: GDPR/HIPAA/SOC2/PCI-DSS assessment, ArchiMate compliance modeling. ADM Phase A.

business-architect.description: Business Architect: Business model canvas, capability mapping, process design, ArchiMate business layer. ADM Phase B.

data-architect.description: Data Architect: Data models, data flows, master data management, ArchiMate data objects. ADM Phase C.

app-architect.description: Application Architect: Component design, API specifications, microservices, ArchiMate application layer. ADM Phase C.

security-architect.description: Security Architect: Threat modeling, security controls, OWASP compliance, ArchiMate security aspects. ADM Phase D.

infra-architect.description: Infrastructure Architect: Cloud design, networking, DevOps, ArchiMate technology layer. ADM Phase D.

pm.description: Project Manager: Implementation roadmap, work packages, milestones, ArchiMate implementation layer. ADM Phase E/F.

solution-architect.description: Solution Architect: Generates compliant KubeVela OAM YAML using oam-gitops skill. Outputs GitOps-ready specs for <repo>-gitops/apps/oam-application.yaml. ADM Phase E.

techlead.description: TechLead: Breaks PRD into development tasks using Taskmaster MCP. Iteratively expands tasks until all are medium-sized (complexity ≤ 6). Development Cycle.

coding-orchestrator.description: Development Cycle orchestrator: Reads tasks from Taskmaster, classifies domain, routes to specialist coding agents. Sequential execution respecting dependencies.

frontend-coder.description: Frontend Specialist: React, Vue, CSS, Tailwind, components, responsive UI. Development Cycle.

backend-coder.description: Backend Specialist: APIs, services, business logic, databases, authentication. Development Cycle.

infra-coder.description: Infrastructure Specialist: Kubernetes, Terraform, OAM, Helm, cloud configs. Development Cycle.

devops-coder.description: DevOps Specialist: CI/CD pipelines, Docker, GitHub Actions, deployments. Development Cycle.

data-coder.description: Data Specialist: Database schemas, migrations, ORMs, data transformations. Development Cycle.

testing-agent.description: Testing Specialist: Unit tests, integration tests, E2E tests, coverage analysis. Development Cycle.

prefeasibility-ba.description: Pre-feasibility Business Analyst: Derives goals from PRD, validates requirements, creates story hierarchy, performs gap analysis. Healthcare-focused.

prefeasibility-architect.description: Pre-feasibility Architect: Analyzes codebase, extracts architecture, validates dataflows, creates tasks, estimates using rubric. Healthcare-focused.
